references.text: The Lord gave the wave offering and the contribution offering from the Israelites to Aaron and his sons as a permanent regulation, as part of the priests' share.
The waved breast and the contributed thigh were to be eaten by Aaron and his sons as their rightful share forever.
The contribution offering from the Israelites was given to Aaron and his sons as an eternal right.
All holy gifts that the Israelites lift up for the Lord are given to Aaron and his sons as a permanent covenant.
The wave offering of the Israelites' gifts was given to Aaron and his sons and daughters as a permanent regulation.
The priests were to eat the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering, and everything devoted to the Lord in Israel belonged to them.
Paul points out that those who serve at the altar receive their share from the offerings, just as the priests did in the Old Testament.
The high priest is appointed to present gifts and sacrifices on behalf of the people, in accordance with the order given to Aaron.
